title: atractylodes lancea
intro: Atractylodes lancea, commonly known as Baizhi in Chinese medicine, is a type of plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Atractylodes lancea include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polysaccharides. These compounds are thought to contribute to the plant's ability to calm the digestive system, lower blood pressure, and enhance overall well-being.
